name: task_wait
description: Wait for one or more task_spawn subagent tasks to complete and collect their results. timeout_secs bounds this call: on expiry it returns the collected results plus a note that the rest are still running — call again with the same task_ids. Responses include pending tasks' latest live progress/checkpoint snapshots. It can also return early with a PARKED status while tasks are still running; re-call with the same task_ids.

task_ids.description: Array of task_id strings returned by task_spawn.

timeout_secs.description: Wait budget in seconds for THIS call (clamped 1–60, default 30). Suspends the parent — call only after independent work is exhausted. Hitting the budget does NOT cancel or stall subagents; they keep running — use task_status while other work remains.

wait_policy.description: 'any' (default) returns on the first finisher; 'all' collects every finished result but returns early (PARKED) while any task is still running; call `task_wait` again with the same task_ids. Remaining tasks stay alive and can be retrieved later.
